query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "claw-swe-bench: a benchmark for evaluating openclaw-style agent harnes" computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it provides an empirical study of the same domain (LLM agents on SWE-Bench) and measures the same underlying mechanisms (agent trajectories, success/failure patterns, and problem-solving strategies) that are central to evaluating and extending benchmarks like "Claw-SWE-Bench." It offers the necessary baseline data on agent behavior and failure modes that a literature review for a new benchmark extension would require to contextualize its contributions
